########################################################################
# Setup library
########################################################################
include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX


list(APPEND rtl433_interface_sources
    rtl_sink_impl.cc ring_buffer.cc
    )

find_library(R_433_LIBRARY
    NAMES r_433
    PATHS /usr/local/lib /usr/lib
)
find_path(R_433_INCLUDE_DIR
    NAMES rtl_433/rtl_433.h
    PATHS /usr/local/include /usr/include
)

if(NOT R_433_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "libr_433 not found — run 'sudo make install' in the rtl_433 build first")
endif()
if(NOT R_433_INCLUDE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "rtl_433 headers not found in ${R_433_INCLUDE_DIR}")
endif()

set(rtl433_interface_sources
    "${rtl433_interface_sources}"
    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT rtl433_interface_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT rtl433_interface_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-rtl433_interface SHARED ${rtl433_interface_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-rtl433_interface gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime)
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-rtl433_interface
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
    PRIVATE RTL433INC)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-rtl433_interface PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_rtl433_interface_EXPORTS")

target_link_libraries(gnuradio-rtl433_interface
    gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime
    ${R_433_LIBRARY}
)

target_include_directories(gnuradio-rtl433_interface
    PRIVATE ${R_433_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-rtl433_interface PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
gr_library_foo(gnuradio-rtl433_interface)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

########################################################################
# Build and register unit test
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

# If your unit tests require special include paths, add them here
#include_directories()
# List all files that contain Boost.UTF unit tests here
list(APPEND test_rtl433_interface_sources)
# Anything we need to link to for the unit tests go here
list(APPEND GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-rtl433_interface)

if(NOT test_rtl433_interface_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ unit tests... skipping")
    return()
endif(NOT test_rtl433_interface_sources)

foreach(qa_file ${test_rtl433_interface_sources})
    gr_add_cpp_test("rtl433_interface_${qa_file}" ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${qa_file})
endforeach(qa_file)
